address: 14 Pham Hong Thai Street, Ben Thanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 71009, Vietnam
bio: This is one outlet of a well-known phở chain, recognised for its rice ribbon noodles made from scratch. Alongside the familiar raw beef and beef balls, a range of cuts such as shank, flank, oxtail and ribs offers contrasting textures and flavours. Each bowl is accompanied by herbs, bean sprouts, onion and lime wedges. For those who like their soup piping hot to the last mouthful, the phở thố đá, served in a heated stone bowl, is the way to go. The broth, sliced beef and noodles are served separately, allowing diners to control the doneness of the beef and adding an interactive element to the meal.
